findings.evidence: `rg` finds `parametrization` only in the structure field; all subsequent constructions use `T.carrier`, its topology, and the framing basis.
findings.fix: Store mere existence of a torus homeomorphism, e.g. `Nonempty (carrier ≃ₜ UnitAddTorus (Fin 2))`, or otherwise make the parametrization part of operations/laws and provide an extensionality theorem.
findings.issue: `BoundaryTorus.parametrization` is unconstrained data unused by `firstHomology`, `FramedBoundaryTorus`, or any slope operation, so equivalent parametrizations of the same framed torus produce unequal bundled objects.

findings.evidence: Lines 124 and 130 mark both definitions `@[expose]`; line 132 states only `(v = w ∨ v = -w) → mk v hv = mk w hw`.
findings.fix: Add `Slope.mk_eq_mk_iff : mk v hv = mk w hw ↔ v = w ∨ v = -w` (with suitable simp annotation), then remove `@[expose]` from `Slope` and `Slope.mk`.
findings.issue: `Slope` and `Slope.mk` expose their quotient bodies, while the API only provides the forward implication `mk_eq_mk`; consumers lack the characteristic equality equivalence and must unfold the representation for elimination such as distinctness.

findings.evidence: Lines 206–212 show the zero branch has `@[simp]` while the nonzero branch does not; lines 349 and 353 are the canonical evaluations of `coord` on the framing basis.
findings.fix: Mark `slopeValue_of_snd_ne_zero`, `coord_basis_zero`, and `coord_basis_one` with `@[simp]` so downstream coordinate/value reductions do not require manual rewrites.
findings.issue: Parallel characteristic equations are inconsistently automated: only `slopeValue_of_snd_eq_zero` is `[simp]`, and the framing coordinate equations at lines 349 and 353 are also unannotated normal forms.

summary: The public slope representation carries unused data and relies on exposed quotient internals instead of a complete characteristic API. Several defining equations also lack normal-form annotations.
